anomalies.name: August F&O Options Turnover Contraction
anomalies.business_context: Sharp collapse in India VIX (implied volatility down to 11.8) coupled with regulatory uncertainty surrounding SEBI index derivative lot-size revisions caused retail option buyers to pull back trading activity.

anomalies.name: August 14 Peak Margin RMS Rejection Spike
anomalies.business_context: Intraday BankNifty 650-point sudden gap-down triggered exchange peak margin snapshot failures, resulting in 14x elevated RMS rejections for retail intraday limit and stop-loss orders.

anomalies.name: Thursday Weekly Expiry Volume Surge
anomalies.business_context: Weekly NSE Nifty 50 contract expiry generates massive scalping, 0DTE theta-decay plays, and algorithmic rollover volume, concentrating up to 38% of total weekly retail turnover on Thursdays.
